data.rationale: The proposal gets the overall flow right (Booking search, xe.com EUR conversion, draft email with the right subject and body), but it omits the review score of 8 or more rule and the do-not-Reserve constraint. It also says to Send when the true workflow ends in Discard, treats recipient as a full address instead of {traveler}@example.com, and adds a redundant recipient_name parameter, so an automation built from it would pick the wrong hotel and send the email.
